operator_design: operator review 2026-10-14: 6-8 frozen tasks with differing fault locations and recovery closures, strict pairing, plus the key ablation DD-v3 (learning) vs DD-v3-NoLearn (frozen priors)

arm_defs.DD_Online: v3 learning: PriorStore(observable-only) + Thompson(seeded) + propagation + closure pricing
arm_defs.DD_Online_NoLearn: identical rule and sampling, store FROZEN at DEV priors (learn disabled) — isolates within-run learning value

primary_contrast: DD-Online vs Fixed-Tuned (paired dU); ablation: DD-Online vs DD-Online-NoLearn
caps_derivation: 8 tasks x 4 arms x (4 planned + up to 3 recovery) <= 224 worst; reservations non-accumulating; DS/qwen cells only cost cash
analysis: full_dag_analyze --run-dir + silver robustness (mandatory) + anchor_hit_ratio (TERMINAL_ANCHOR_PACKAGE, pending human confirmation) + decision attribution (per-decision prior uncertainty + Thompson-sample logged)
interpretive_guards: MDE ~0.05 dU/task is conditional on simulated variance — below-threshold results reported as undetectable, not no-effect
tasks share few events -> treat paired tests as exploratory, report per-task deltas
if DD ~= Fixed but DD ~= NoLearn improves over tasks, attribute to learning; if NoLearn ~= DD, gains come from the static selection rule, not learning
